about: A simple two-factor authenticator app for the desktop.

prs.title: Bitwarden vaults import their two-factor codes
prs.broken: Importing a Bitwarden export did nothing, with no error, for most real vaults. Secure notes, cards, and keys typed in by hand stopped the whole import.
prs.changed: Items without a two-factor key are now skipped, and keys typed in by hand are turned into proper entries, as the 2FAS import already does.
prs.matters: People moving from Bitwarden get their codes in one go instead of a button that silently fails.
